main_text.head: EPIST. LXXXVII.
J. Morinus Lucæ Holstenio antiqvam amicitiam renovat.
main_text.p: Clarissimo & Eruditissimo D. Holstenio Bibliot. Vatic. custodi Joann. Morinus Cong. Orat. Presbyter.

JAm longum tempus elapsum est, cla-rissime Holsteni, cùm literis tecum non egi; non ideo tamen existimo mei oblivionem te cepisse, nam non modo tanta cum amicitiæ & familiaritatis de-monstratione me Romæ viventem complexus es, verum etiam anteqvam Romā accederem, me æstimatione & laude tua ita commendabilem reddidisti, ut mei memoriam in animo tuo nunqvam abo-leri posse confidam; his ergo fretus antiqvam amicitiam nostrā hac Epistola re-novaturus nihil tibi injucundum aut im-portunum me facturum spero. Vive igi-tur felix mei nonnunqvam memor, amicitiæ & obseqvii mei securus; nihil tibi tam honorificum & eminens continge-re potest, qvod votis non præcipiam & præoptem. Parisiis xvij. Kal. Nov. An. MDCLIV.

page.notes: The date line reads "clɔIɔ CLIV." in the scan, rendered as MDCLIV (the reversed-C numerals cIↄ = M, Iↄ = D). The "J" of "JAm" is a drop cap, kept as printed. The catchword "EPIST." sits alone at the bottom right. Left-edge scan marks and the faint bottom mark are not printed text and are omitted.
